133137001.title: File:Aerial view of the Dakshin Gangotri under construction.jpg

ObjectName.value: Aerial view of the Dakshin Gangotri under construction

Categories.value: Dakshin Gangotri|Items with VRTS permission confirmed|Construction in Antarctica|Photos donated by Col Pavan Nair

ImageDescription.value:
An aerial view of Dakshin Gangotri research station under construction. Living tents for the construction party on the top left. 
Photo donated by Col Pavan Nair (now-retired) who was then a Major in the Indian Army. He led the construction team for the Dakshin Gangotri base station in Antarctica.

Photo donated by Col Pavan Nair who was then a major in the Indian Army, and led the construction team for the Dakshin Gangotri base station in Antarctica.
